description: This PHP class defines options for invocation tags in the Revive Adserver, including methods for generating HTML form elements for various configuration options such as campaign ID, banner ID, target, charset, and window options.

classes.name: Plugins_InvocationTagsOptions
classes.description: A class providing configuration options for invocation tags, including methods to generate HTML form elements for various options.

methods.name: setInvocation
methods.description: Sets the reference to the invocation object.

methods.name: spacer
methods.description: Generates an HTML spacer row.

methods.name: what
methods.description: Generates HTML for the 'what' configuration option.

methods.name: campaignid
methods.description: Generates HTML for selecting a campaign ID.

methods.name: bannerid
methods.description: Generates HTML for inputting a banner ID.

methods.name: target
methods.description: Generates HTML for selecting a target window.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Generates HTML for inputting a source URL.

methods.name: withtext
methods.description: Generates HTML for choosing whether to include text.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Generates HTML for iframe refresh timing.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Generates HTML for setting frame size.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Returns HTML for resize option (hidden input).

methods.name: transparent
methods.description: Generates HTML for making iframe transparent.

methods.name: ilayer
methods.description: Generates HTML for including Netscape 4 layer.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Generates HTML for blocking ad display.

methods.name: blockcampaign
methods.description: Generates HTML for blocking campaign display.

methods.name: raw
methods.description: Generates HTML for raw template option.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: Generates HTML for popup delay options.

methods.name: absolute
methods.description: Generates HTML for popup position (top and left).

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Generates HTML for auto-close timeout.

methods.name: windowoptions
methods.description: Generates HTML for window options like toolbars, location, menubar, etc.

methods.name: xmlrpcproto
methods.description: Generates HTML for XML-RPC protocol option.

methods.name: xmlrpctimeout
methods.description: Generates HTML for XML-RPC timeout.

methods.name: hostlanguage
methods.description: Generates HTML for selecting host language.

methods.name: cacheBuster
methods.description: Generates HTML for cache buster option.

methods.name: comments
methods.description: Generates HTML for comments inclusion option.

methods.name: charset
methods.description: Generates HTML for charset selection.

methods.name: https
methods.description: Generates HTML for HTTPS tags option.

methods.name: _getAvailableCharsets
methods.description: Returns a list of available character sets based on PHP extensions.
